jobs.title: Housing Case Manager – Rising Up
jobs.description:
3rd Street Youth Center \& Clinic is a community\-based agency providing youth in the Bayview Hunters Point with medical and behavioral health services that encourage them to make decisions that support their health, safety and development. The Housing Case Manager will provide comprehensive case management to TAY youth placed into housing via San Francisco's Rising Up initiative.

  

Rising Up is a public/private partnership launched by Mayor London Breed in support of the broader city\-wide goal of reducing homelessness for youth ages 18\-25 by 50% by 2023, ultimately assuring that homelessness for young people is rare, brief, and one\-time.

  

The Housing Case Manager will provide comprehensive case management to TAY youth placed into housing via San Francisco's Rising Up initiative.

 **Duties \& Responsibilities:**

  

The following is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Housing Case Manager. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed.

* Individual case management \& oversight to TAY referred from the Coordinated Entry System, including twice monthly home visits.
* Resource brokerage and referral as needed
* Case coordination and advocacy within agency and with other CBO's
* Data collection and case notes entered into all appropriate databases.
* Support Rapid Rehousing Coordinator in all aspects of HomePoint (3rd Street's Rapid


Rehousing program)

* Designing individual support \& transition plan with youth including independent living skills


and income stability.

* Attend community, city, \& regional housing meetings
* Support for staff \& youth in 3rd Street programming as needed

**About you:**


You possess the following …

* Ability to connect with our youth
* Ability to maintain a professional demeanor with great interpersonal and communication
* skills
* Ability to multi\-task with the capacity to learn quickly and integrate efficiently
* Ability to work with minimal to moderate supervision
* Ability to multi\-task and efficiently manage priority action items
* Ability to work with a diverse staff and excel in a multicultural environment.
* Exceptional organizational skills with reliability and consistency in work performance
* Flexibility with a team player mentality
* An extreme focus on good judgment with a proactive approach to problem\-solving
* An upbeat attitude


You are able to …

* Perform tasks and responsibilities in a complete and timely manner, complying with


agency policies and standards and conforming to the requirements of this job

* Maintain professional standards of performance, demeanor and appearance at all times


description

* Maintain a creative, team\-building, cooperative approach to job performance and seek to


bring a constructive, problem\-solving orientation to all tasks.

* Maintain an awareness of the agency's mission and work to promote the positive individual


and social change goals it embodies.

* Exercise discretion and professional judgment at all times keeping with the responsibilities


carried personally and by the agency for the care and welfare of staff and to the youth in


which we serve.

* Actively strive to upgrade professional skills through engaging in appropriate professional


training and experience.

* Maintain the strictest of confidentiality.

 **Qualifications:**

* Bachelors in related field OR equivalent work
* 2\-3 years of experience working with high\-risk and homeless youth
* Ability to notice symptoms of use and abuse, recovery and treatment philosophies

jobs.title: Housing Navigator
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY**:



The Housing Navigator is responsible for diversion, housing\-focused case management, community referrals, housing placement, and linking families with the appropriate destination for continued services.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Form and foster relationships with housing agencies and permanent housing providers, including supportive housing providers.
* Partner with housing agencies and providers to offer the Member permanent, independent housing options, including supportive housing.
* Connect and assist the Member in getting available permanent housing.
* Coordinate with members in the most easily accessible setting within MCP guidelines (e.g., could be a mobile unit that engages members on the street).
* Conduct or review intake and assessment for family/everyone accessing services to evaluate housing needs, history, and service/support needs. Develop and implement a housing\-focused individual opportunity plan in collaboration with each Member.
* Conduct a tenant screening and housing assessment that identifies the member’s preferences and barriers related to successful tenancy. The assessment may include collecting information on the member’s housing needs, potential housing transition barriers, and identification of housing retention barriers.
* Develop an individualized housing support plan based upon the housing assessment that addresses identified barriers, includes short\- and long\-term measurable goals for each issue, establishes the member’s approach to meeting the goal, and identifies when other providers or services, both reimbursed and not reimbursed by Medi\-Cal, may be required to meet the goal.
* Search for housing and presenting options.
* Assist in securing housing, including the completion of housing applications and securing required documentation (e.g., Social Security card, birth certificate, prior rental history).
* Assist with benefits advocacy, including assistance with obtaining identification and documentation for SSI eligibility and supporting the SSI application process.
* Identify and secure available resources to assist with subsidizing rent (such as HUD’s Housing Choice Voucher Program (Section 8\), or state and local assistance programs) and match available rental subsidy resources to Members.
* Identify and secure resources to cover expenses, such as security deposit, moving costs, adaptive aids, environmental modifications, moving costs, and other one\-time expenses.
* Assist with requests for reasonable accommodation, if necessary.
* Landlord education and engagement
* Ensure that the living environment is safe and ready for move\-in.
* Communicate and advocate on behalf of the Member with landlords.
* Assist in arranging for and supporting the details of the move
* Identify, and coordinate non\-medical transportation to assist Members’ mobility to ensure reasonable accommodations and access to housing options prior to transition and on move in day
* Provide early identification and intervention for behaviors that may jeopardize housing, such as late rental payment, hoarding, substance use, and other lease violations.
* Educate and train on the role, rights, and responsibilities of the tenant and landlord.
* Coach on developing and maintaining key relationships with landlords/property managers with a goal of fostering successful tenancy.
* Coordinate with the landlord and case management provider to address identified issues that could impact housing stability.
* Provide assistance in resolving disputes with landlords and/or neighbors to reduce the risk of eviction or other adverse action, including developing a repayment plan or identifying funding in situations in which the Member owes back rent or payment for damage to the unit.
* Provide advocacy and linkage with community resources to prevent eviction when housing is or may potentially become jeopardized.
* Assist with benefits advocacy, including assistance with obtaining identification and documentation for SSI eligibility and supporting the SSI application process. Such service can be subcontracted out to retain needed specialized skillset.
* Assist with the annual housing recertification process.
* Coordinate with the tenant to review, update and modify their housing support and crisis plan on a regular basis to reflect current needs and address existing or recurring housing retention barriers.
* Continue assistance with lease compliance, including ongoing support with activities related to household management.
* Conduct Health and safety visits, including unit habitability inspections.
* Perform other prevention and early intervention services identified in the crisis plan that are activated when housing is jeopardized (e.g., assisting with reasonable accommodation requests that were not initially required upon move\-in).
* Provide independent living and life skills including assistance with and training on budgeting, including financial literacy and connection to community resources.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:**



Paraprofessional or other qualification based on experience and knowledge of the population and processes.


**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**


* Paraprofessional with at least 2 years of experience or Associates Degree in a social service field, LCSW, or MSW


* Experience working with individuals and/or families experiencing homelessness and case management experience or similar work experience, preferred.

  


**SKILL AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS:**


* Ability to work independently and possess strong time management skills. Strong ability to manage time using an online or paper calendar.


* Knowledge and familiarity with harm reduction and motivational interviewing concepts and strategies.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator / Care Navigator
jobs.description:
**Full job description**
------------------------


Care Navigator

**Pay: $25–$28 per hour**


About Nurse Next Door


Our purpose is **Making Lives Better through Happier Aging**. We help seniors stay in their homes for as long as they choose, and our real talent is caring and connecting to seniors’ hearts. We have a mission to help seniors continue doing what they love most.


We are not just another home care company fulfilling daily tasks. We are a company that admires people and seeks to make a difference in everything we do. By working at Nurse Next Door, you will be part of a growing company that is helping seniors do what they love again.


As a member of the Nurse Next Door team, you understand how to **hustle with heart**\—this is essential! You enjoy working collaboratively while maintaining a high degree of autonomy and thrive by seeing results. You are a self\-led leader who takes responsibility for your own actions. You show care by engaging in intentional, compassionate conversations to help others achieve their fullest potential.


You are inspired by the idea of being involved with an organization that is changing the way we deliver home care through our **Happier Aging** philosophy.


Position Summary


As a **Care Designer**, you are responsible for the day\-to\-day operations related to driving business results through client experience and caregiver management. You will drive growth through the following main duties and responsibilities:


Consult Conversion

* Conduct Caring Consults and assess clients with respect to their physical, emotional, and environmental needs.
* Advise clients on appropriate care and achieve a **90% conversion goal**.
* Drive business interest by engaging in relationships with community leaders and professional organizations to establish long\-term relationships that translate into word\-of\-mouth and professional referrals.
* Develop, promote, and ensure high\-quality, innovative customer service.
* Act as an advisor during Caring Consults to ensure that clients and client contacts have all the information required.


Client Care Delivery and Experience

* Attend all First Visits with caregivers to ensure client needs and care plans are executed according to the Service Agreement.
* Set and role\-model expectations for caregivers.
* Conduct supervisory visits to ensure caregiver fit and quality of care while delivering a premium client experience and impacting Net Promoter Scores of **9 or higher**.
* Develop appropriate and individualized care plans and update them as required.
* Educate clients on self\-care and evaluate client responses to care provided.
* Monitor risk issues, analyze trends, and adapt care as needed.
* Coordinate care, implement solutions, and evaluate client outcomes based on client goals.


People Leadership

* Drive results by leading your caregiving team through clear goal\-setting, task assignment, in\-the\-moment coaching, and continuing education.
* Deliver on our Brand Promise by leading the client experience and ensuring caregivers are doing whatever it takes to bring peace of mind to our clients and their families.
* Be accountable for staff performance, ensuring caregiver availability meets business needs and that there is compliance with all systems.
* Manage the education function to support a continuous learning environment and staff utilization of learning opportunities.
* Support **Discovery Day** and monthly in\-service programs.
* Conduct First and Supervisory Visits to evaluate caregiver performance and job satisfaction, impacting the employee experience and resulting in a Net Promoter Score of **9 or higher**.


Scheduling Collaboration

* Hand off accurate and timely client and employee files to the Care Services (CSC) team to deliver exceptional client service by achieving scheduling goals and responding to urgent inquiries.
* Liaise with the CSC team to communicate changes in client requirements and caregiver assignments.
* Ensure client coverage is secured, particularly due to urgent care needs, caregiver cancellations, and limited availability.
* Assist with scheduling as needed.
* Ensure AMS (Attendance Monitoring Investigations – ALAYACARE) percentages remain below **5%** for total staff.
* Manage caregiver performance related to attendance and scheduling.
* Ensure data integrity and completion of caregiver and client files in the scheduling software.


Administration

* Maintain excellent documentation practices, specifically complete and accurate care plans, employee files (skills and qualifications), and client files, including pay and billing information.
* Review and update client and staff records quarterly to ensure **100% accuracy and completeness**.
* Direct the maintenance of client and personnel records to meet employee, organizational, and statutory requirements and entitlements.
* Conduct quarterly record audits to ensure accuracy and up\-to\-date information.
* Ensure compliance with national, state/provincial legislative requirements in areas such as health, employment, and occupational health and safety.
* Approve all visits and premiums in preparation for each payroll and billing cycle.


Availability

* Flexibility is required.
* Full\-time.
* On\-call availability from **9:00 AM to 6:00 PM**, including evenings and weekends, as needed.


Business Relationships

* Reports to the Franchise Partner.
* Leads the caregiving team.
* Works closely in partnership with the Care Services Center.


Key Metrics

* Consult Conversion
* Driving Revenue
* NPS; Client and Employee Score of **10**


QualificationsEducation Requirements

* Nursing background is considered an asset.
* CPR and First Aid Certification.
* Car and valid driver's license.
* Background or Criminal Record Check with a Vulnerable Sector Search, updated every 5 years for continued employment.
* Negative TB test, updated every 5 years for continued employment.


Experience Requirements

* Strong computer skills

jobs.title: Med Spa Patient Care Coordinator (Sales Consultant)
jobs.description:
Ageless Aesthetics Fresno is looking for a highly motivated, polished, and sales\-driven team member to assist with daily clinic operations while primarily focusing on selling treatment packages, upselling services, nurturing leads, and converting inquiries into booked consultations and paying clients.

This is not just an administrative position. We are looking for someone who understands sales, follows up consistently, knows how to build trust with clients, and can confidently guide leads toward booking and purchasing services.

**Responsibilities**

The ideal candidate will help with daily operations while taking ownership of the client conversion process, including:

* Responding to leads by phone, text, email, and social media
* Following up with warm leads and reactivating past inquiries
* Booking consultations and treatment appointments
* Selling treatment packages and membership\-style offers
* Upselling additional services when appropriate
* Educating clients on available treatments in a professional, luxury tone
* Maintaining client communication before and after visits
* Assisting with front desk, scheduling, intake forms, and daily clinic flow
* Supporting marketing campaigns, promotions, and client outreach
* Tracking lead activity, follow\-ups, bookings, and conversions
* Helping create a smooth, high\-end client experience from first contact to checkout

**Requirements**

* Must have proven sales experience
* Must be comfortable selling packages and upselling services
* Experience in med spa, aesthetics, beauty, wellness, plastic surgery, dermatology, or healthcare sales is strongly preferred
* Must be able to provide proof of past sales success, references, results, or examples of previous performance
* Strong communication and follow\-up skills
* Confident, polished, professional, and friendly personality
* Comfortable speaking with clients about pricing, treatments, and financing options
* Organized and able to manage multiple leads at once
* Reliable, punctual, and self\-motivated
* Experience with CRM systems, social media DMs, or booking software is a plus

**Compensation \& Perks**

* Compensation

***Competitive hourly pay plus commission/bonus opportunities based on performance and sales results.***

**Ideal Candidate**

You are someone who enjoys sales, understands client psychology, and knows how to turn interest into action. You are not pushy, but you are confident, persuasive, and consistent. You know how to make clients feel comfortable, educated, and excited to move forward.

You should be able to help us increase bookings, package sales, upgrades, and repeat client visits.

This is a part\-time position and starting hours will be around 10\-20 hours a week. Availability wednesday\-sunday is preferred.

**How to Apply**

Please upload your resume along with a short message explaining your sales experience. Applicants with med spa, aesthetics, beauty, or wellness sales experience will be prioritized.

Please include proof of previous sales performance, such as references, sales numbers, screenshots, client conversion examples, or prior employer verification if available.

Pay: $18\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid training

Experience:

* Sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Newport Beach, California \| Full\-Time**

A growing Newport Beach plastic surgery practice led by a nationally recognized plastic surgeon is seeking an exceptional and highly experienced **Senior Patient Care Coordinator** to join our team.

This is **not an entry\-level administrative position**. We are looking for a proven cosmetic surgery professional who understands the psychology of the aesthetic patient, knows how to build trust and communicate value, and has demonstrated success converting qualified consultations into booked surgical procedures.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional interpersonal skills with strong sales instincts, organization, professionalism, and genuine patient care. You should be comfortable working with discerning cosmetic patients considering high\-value elective procedures and understand that successful aesthetic sales are built through education, responsiveness, trust, follow\-through, and an exceptional patient experience.

The Role

The Senior Patient Care Coordinator serves as one of the primary relationships between our patients and surgeon, guiding prospective patients from their initial inquiry and consultation through surgery and the postoperative experience.

Your primary responsibility will be to **develop strong patient relationships, communicate the value of our surgeons and services, and convert qualified prospective patients into booked surgical procedures while delivering an exceptional level of service.**

Responsibilities include:

* Conduct comprehensive cosmetic surgery consultations and guide patients through their treatment options and surgical journey.
* Clearly communicate procedure recommendations, surgeon qualifications, expected patient experience, fees, financing options, and practice policies.
* Prepare accurate surgical proposals and financial quotes and follow prospective patients through the decision\-making process.
* Build trust, identify patient concerns, navigate objections thoughtfully, and convert qualified consultations into booked procedures.
* Proactively and consistently follow up with new inquiries, consultations, previous leads, and prospective patients through phone, text, email, and CRM systems.
* Reactivate prior inquiries and consultations and identify opportunities for repeat procedures and patient referrals.
* Coordinate surgical scheduling, deposits, financing, preoperative requirements, and communication between patients, surgeons, clinical staff, and surgical facilities.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation within the practice EMR and CRM.
* Provide outstanding communication and concierge\-level service throughout the preoperative, perioperative, and postoperative experience.
* Collaborate with the practice's marketing team to maximize lead conversion, identify patient acquisition opportunities, support events and internal marketing initiatives, and strengthen patient referrals.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and adherence to HIPAA and all applicable practice policies.

Who We Are Looking For

The successful candidate will have **at least five years of meaningful Patient Care Coordinator experience within cosmetic plastic surgery or a closely related high\-end aesthetic medical environment.**

Strong candidates will demonstrate:

* A proven track record of successfully converting cosmetic consultations into booked procedures.
* Significant experience discussing and closing high\-value elective surgical procedures.
* A sophisticated understanding of the cosmetic patient and the ability to establish trust without relying on high\-pressure sales tactics.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills in person, by phone, text, and email.
* A warm, polished, professional, confident, and highly service\-oriented presence.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and the ability to manage a large pipeline of prospective patients without allowing opportunities to fall through the cracks.
* Excellent organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience with EMR and CRM platforms and confidence learning new technology.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office and modern digital communication platforms.
* Experience with patient financing and financial discussions surrounding elective procedures.
* The ability to work independently, take ownership of results, and identify opportunities to improve patient conversion and the overall patient experience.
* High integrity, discretion, accountability, and respect for patient confidentiality.

Experience with practice growth, internal marketing, social media, events, referral development, or aesthetic practice management is a significant plus.

**Orange County candidates and candidates with established experience in the Southern California cosmetic surgery market are preferred.**

What Success Looks Like

We are looking for someone who views this position as more than scheduling and administration.

A successful coordinator will become a trusted extension of our surgeon and an advocate for our patients. You will understand where every prospective patient is within the decision\-making process, follow up consistently and intelligently, and help patients feel confident and well cared for from their first interaction with the practice.

Performance will be measured not simply by activity, but by **patient experience, responsiveness, consultation conversion, surgical bookings, follow\-up discipline, and contribution to the growth of the practice.**

Compensation \& Schedule

**Full\-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM**  
Newport Beach, California

Compensation will include a **competitive base salary plus performance\-based incentive compensation**, with significant earning potential for an experienced, high\-performing cosmetic surgery coordinator.

Specific compensation will be based on experience and demonstrated performance.

How to Apply

jobs.description:
**About the Role (read to the end):**

Moving and Grooving Pediatric Physical Therapy is seeking a Patient Care Coordinator focused on inbound sales, appointment conversion, and lead follow\-up.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant or virtual assistant role.

You will speak with prospective families, understand why they are seeking care, explain our pediatric PT/OT services and cash\-pay model, respond to questions or hesitation, and confidently guide qualified families toward scheduling an evaluation. You will also gather information/ data to track metrics each month, organize and present this data in an easy to follow manner.

**Responsibilities:**

* Answer inbound calls, texts, and emails from prospective families
* Build rapport and identify the family’s main concern
* Explain services, pricing, and the cash\-pay/out\-of\-network model
* Ask qualified families to schedule an evaluation
* Handle common objections involving cost, insurance, scheduling, and hesitation
* Follow up until each lead schedules, declines, or is formally closed
* Document calls, objections, next steps, and follow\-up dates in the CRM, GoHighLevel
* Ensure intake paperwork is completed before appointments
* Maintain timely, professional communication with families

**Qualifications:**

* Excellent spoken English and strong phone presence
* Warm, confident, conversational communication style
* Strong active\-listening skills
* Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the appointment
* Ability to follow a script while adapting to the conversation
* Strong follow\-up and CRM/documentation habits
* Reliable internet and ability to work independently
* Strong written communication and organization

*Preferred experience:*

* Inbound sales
* Appointment setting
* Patient intake
* Lead conversion
* Healthcare customer service or sales
* Inside sales
* CRM/lead\-management systems

**Schedule:**

* Part\-time
* Remote
* Consistent weekday daytime availability required
* Must be available during agreed\-upon business hours to respond to inbound leads

**Compensation:**

This position includes an hourly base rate plus performance\-based commission tied to successful lead conversion. Total earnings can reach up to $22/hour based on performance, paid as a W2 employee.

**About Moving and Grooving:**

Moving and Grooving Pediatric Physical Therapy provides pediatric PT and OT services through clinic\-based and mobile care.

We operate on a cash\-pay and out\-of\-network model, allowing our team to focus on individualized care without traditional insurance authorization limitations.

We are looking for someone who can make families feel heard while confidently helping them take the next step.

If you are interested, please follow the following steps:

Submit your resume along with a link to a 1\-2 minute video with the following included: introducing yourself/ who you are; tell me 3 words to describe yourself; tell me why you think you'd be a good fit for this role/ share relevant experience in prior jobs.

**\*Do NOT call the business line or inquire in any other manner except for in response to this post.**

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.company: Moving and Grooving Pediatric Physical Therapy
new_jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role (read to the end):**

Moving and Grooving Pediatric Physical Therapy is seeking a Patient Care Coordinator focused on inbound sales, appointment conversion, and lead follow\-up.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant or virtual assistant role.

You will speak with prospective families, understand why they are seeking care, explain our pediatric PT/OT services and cash\-pay model, respond to questions or hesitation, and confidently guide qualified families toward scheduling an evaluation. You will also gather information/ data to track metrics each month, organize and present this data in an easy to follow manner.

**Responsibilities:**

* Answer inbound calls, texts, and emails from prospective families
* Build rapport and identify the family’s main concern
* Explain services, pricing, and the cash\-pay/out\-of\-network model
* Ask qualified families to schedule an evaluation
* Handle common objections involving cost, insurance, scheduling, and hesitation
* Follow up until each lead schedules, declines, or is formally closed
* Document calls, objections, next steps, and follow\-up dates in the CRM, GoHighLevel
* Ensure intake paperwork is completed before appointments
* Maintain timely, professional communication with families

**Qualifications:**

* Excellent spoken English and strong phone presence
* Warm, confident, conversational communication style
* Strong active\-listening skills
* Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the appointment
* Ability to follow a script while adapting to the conversation
* Strong follow\-up and CRM/documentation habits
* Reliable internet and ability to work independently
* Strong written communication and organization

*Preferred experience:*

* Inbound sales
* Appointment setting
* Patient intake
* Lead conversion
* Healthcare customer service or sales
* Inside sales
* CRM/lead\-management systems

**Schedule:**

* Part\-time
* Remote
* Consistent weekday daytime availability required
* Must be available during agreed\-upon business hours to respond to inbound leads

**Compensation:**

This position includes an hourly base rate plus performance\-based commission tied to successful lead conversion. Total earnings can reach up to $22/hour based on performance, paid as a W2 employee.

**About Moving and Grooving:**

Moving and Grooving Pediatric Physical Therapy provides pediatric PT and OT services through clinic\-based and mobile care.

We operate on a cash\-pay and out\-of\-network model, allowing our team to focus on individualized care without traditional insurance authorization limitations.

We are looking for someone who can make families feel heard while confidently helping them take the next step.

If you are interested, please follow the following steps:

Submit your resume along with a link to a 1\-2 minute video with the following included: introducing yourself/ who you are; tell me 3 words to describe yourself; tell me why you think you'd be a good fit for this role/ share relevant experience in prior jobs.

**\*Do NOT call the business line or inquire in any other manner except for in response to this post.**

Job Type: Part\-time

Pay: $18\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote
